name: FT-Dojo
description: Fine-tuning large language models for vertical domains remains labor-intensive, requiring practitioners to curate data, configure training, and iteratively diagnose model behavior. Despite growing interest in autonomous machine learning and language agents, end-to-end LLM fine-tuning has not been systematically studied as an interactive agent task. We introduce FT-Dojo, an interactive benchmark environment for autonomous LLM fine-tuning, comprising 13 tasks across 5 domains.
